title: wss-guide: typing sender cross-reference too vague to be actionable
description: The guide says 'The mechanism by which a sender signals typing state to the server is defined outside this spec — see the main JMAP Chat spec or the federation spec for the relevant method.' A client developer implementing the send side cannot find the method from this. Name the method explicitly.
notes: Blocked by jmap-chat-spec-53o — the spec itself is missing the owner-facing typing method. Cannot fix the guide cross-reference until the spec defines the method.
